title: Michigan brother ploughs landscaped strip beside sibling's home, triggering bitter land dispute
summary_full: A Michigan appeals court revived a couple's claim over a 0.13-acre strip allegedly landscaped by their family for years. The dispute began after the husband's brother ploughed the land in 2022. The court ruled that a 1991 foreclosure judgment did not prevent the boundary claim, while leaving the $5,364.44 award for trespass and waste undisturbed.
